title: Leave Travel Allowance Bill Generator
name: LTA Bill
summary: Bus or train e-ticket for a leave travel allowance claim.
description: Create a bus or train e-ticket for a leave travel allowance (LTA) claim with the operator, boarding and dropping points, passengers, seat, fare, {tax} and the cancellation terms. Two designs; preview instantly and download as PDF.
intro: A bus or train e-ticket records a journey. In India it is the kind of document attached to a leave travel allowance (LTA) claim: it shows the operator, the boarding and dropping points, the passengers, the seat, the fare and the cancellation terms.

print.t1_banner: Congratulations! You have booked a reschedulable ticket. You can advance or postpone this journey till {when}.
print.mticket_note: NOTE: This operator accepts mobile tickets; you need not carry a printout.
print.gst_note: ({rate}% {tax} and service charge applicable, if any)
print.t1_term_0: Please note the following regarding the luggage policy for your journey.
print.t1_term_1: Each passenger may carry one bag of up to 10 kg and one personal item such as a laptop bag, handbag or briefcase of up to 5 kg.
print.t1_term_2: Passengers must not carry weapons, flammable items, firearms, ammunition, drugs, liquor, smuggled goods or any other articles prohibited by law.
print.t1_term_3: The operator may deny boarding or charge extra if a passenger carries more luggage than allowed.
print.t1_term_4: Partial cancellation is NOT allowed for this ticket. The charges for cancelling the whole ticket are shown below.

print.note_id: Carry a valid photo ID for passenger verification during boarding.
print.note_changes: For travel changes, contact operator support before the cutoff time.
